title: Handley Page Halifax RT922
memorial_details: Stoen cairn surmounted by tapered capstone. Dedicatory inscription engraved on stainless steel plaque on front of cairn. Coloured crest of 47 Squadron and a blue, yellow and red pennon depicted on top of plaque. Badge of the RAF Association and the Blue Circle Company symbol towards the base.
inscription: HALIFAX RT 922/ ON THE 13 FEBRUARY 1947, HALIFAX RT 922 OF 47 SQUADRON ROYAL AIR FORCE,/ CRASHED ADJACENT TO THIS CAIRN DURING A MISSION TO AIRDROP SUPPLIES TO THE/ SNOW-BOUND COMMUNITIES OF GRINDON AND THE SURROUNDING AREAS./ THE CREW AND PASSENGERS WERE ALL KILLED/ THE CREW/ Sqn Ldr Donald McIntyre/ Flt Lt Ernest Smith/ WO Gordon Victor Chapman/ WO Richard Sydney Kearns/ Flt Sgt Kenneth Charles Pettit/ Sgt William Thomas Sherry/ PASSENGERS - PRESS PHOTOGRAPHERS/ David William Savill/ Joseph John Reardon
narrative: The inscription mentions the crash was during a mission to airdrop supplies to the snow-bound communities of Grindon and the surrounding areas.
community_connection: Passengers described explicitly as Press Photographers; inscription states crew and passengers were ALL KILLED
